sloka: स पितुर्वचनं श्रीमानभिषेकात् परं प्रियम् ।मनसा पूर्वमासाद्य वाचा प्रतिगृहीतवान् ।। ५.३३.२५।।।।
transliteration: sa piturvacanaṁ śrīmānabhiṣekāt paraṁ priyam ।manasā pūrvamāsādya vācā pratigṛhītavān ।। 5.33.25।।।।

translations.english: "Rama, whose strength was his truthfulness, gave whatever others sought but would not accept anything in return. He would not speak a harsh word.
